name: Sakuya
quote: With this greenery, I shall construct a verdant world of great repose.

voices.label: Good Morning
voices.text: Good morning, Professor. Can you smell the aroma of anemone flowers in the air?

voices.label: Good Afternoon
voices.text: Regardless of the weather, the flower garden is always nicely lit.

voices.label: Good Evening
voices.text: When it comes to watering flowers, timing is important. In the summer, watering in the evenings would be best, but you can't do the same in the winter.

voices.label: Good Night
voices.text: Certain flowers, like Tuberose and Marvel-of-Peru, only bloom at night.

voices.label: Main Interface Voice 1
voices.text: Every flower's beauty is different. The beauty of Epiphyllum lies in the moment of blossom, while the Sakura is most beautiful when it's fading.

voices.label: Main Interface Voice 2
voices.text: Done... When pruning the branches, extra care should be taken to make sure we don't injure the flowers.

voices.label: Main Interface Voice 3
voices.text: Professor... Oh... Did you fall asleep? Then I'll leave you alone.

voices.label: Home Screen 5
voices.text: Today is another day of tending to the plants in the Oasis. I'll greatly appreciate it if you'd lend me a hand.

voices.label: Interactive Voice 1
voices.text: Hehe...

voices.label: Interactive Voice 2
voices.text: It's a wonderful sight.

voices.label: Interactive Voice 3
voices.text: Um... Is there anything wrong?

voices.label: On Duty
voices.text: Leave it to me.

voices.label: Obtain
voices.text: My name is Sakuya. I'll be at your service from today onwards.

voices.label: Potential Breakthrough
voices.text: My hands feel more nimble.

voices.label: Neural Expansion
voices.text: Wow... With what I can do now, perhaps I can make the plants grow even stronger!

voices.label: Max Rank
voices.text: I will keep doing my best to create an environment where everyone feels at home...

voices.label: Join Team
voices.text: I will do my best to answer to your expectations.

voices.label: Battle Start
voices.text: Let's go explore the unknown.

voices.label: Ultimate Skill
voices.text: Unforgivable!

voices.label: MVP 1
voices.text: Great!

voices.label: MVP 2
voices.text: I did it!

voices.label: Defeat
voices.text: Is this the end of me...

voices.label: Oath
voices.text: I never dreamed you'd choose me... Professor, would you spend some alone time together with me, among this sea of flowers?

voices.label: New Year
voices.text: Be sure to put "Kadomatsu" at your front door on New Year's Day. Pile up pine and bamboo branches together, then decorate them with colorful ornaments. It's said to bring you the blessings of the god of good luck.

voices.label: Valentine's Day
voices.text: Umm, please accept this flower arrangement. It's a combination of shirayuki and tsukihana flowers. It's not as gorgeous as red roses, but I wanted to express my feelings with certain colors and varieties. That... Please don't misunderstand me, it doesn't mean anything bad!

voices.label: Tanabata
voices.text: Peonies symbolize departure. It fits the origin of Tanabata surprisingly well... Still, it would be better if such sad departures never happen to us. Don't you think so, Professor?

voices.label: Halloween
voices.text: Actually, besides making pumpkin pies, pumpkins are good for flower arrangements too. However, your choices for flower colors are limited. Gerberas and golden tulips pair the best with pumpkin flowers.

voices.label: Christmas
voices.text: I made a flower wreath to celebrate Christmas. They're all real flowers... If we put it right here in the center of the living room, people will surely love it.

voices.label: Birthday Wish
voices.text: Happy birthday, Professor. I handmade this aroma oil for you. It's hardly worth mentioning, but I will be really happy if you would accept it as my gift.

voices.label: Neural Cloud
voices.text: Neural Cloud

voices.label: Intimacy 1
voices.text:
The leaves and branches of plants are quite delicate. To prune them, one must be extra careful...
Otherwise, the plants could get gravely injured.
That being said, the plant would be at risk of pest infections without timely trimming... Eek! Professor! Please get that bug away from me!

voices.label: Intimacy 2
voices.text:
Fragrant potted plants in the office are good as decorations, and they help to relieve fatigue.
Which do you prefer, lavender or freesia? They both smell great.

voices.label: Intimacy 3
voices.text:
This one is the anemone flower, my personal favorite. It was named after a Greek mythology character...
A maid named Anemone served Flora, the goddess of flowers. Flora saw her acting intimate with the man she loved, and turned her into a flower out of jealousy...
What a sad story.

voices.label: Intimacy 4
voices.text:
Hmm... What are these, you ask? Are you asking about this pair of large scissors?
It's reserved for cutting down thick trunks and branches. Small scissors won't work with those.
Besides, it is an effective weapon against the ill-intentioned...
Please, there's no need to be so scared.

voices.label: Intimacy 5
voices.text:
My...dream? Hmm... I don't really bring it up often...
My dream is to open my own flower shop one day. It's fine if I have no customers. I'll be content to just sit in my own little house surrounded by flowers and plants.

voices.label: Surprised
voices.text: Ehh…

career:
The LG-II was considered one of the best Doll products of the year when they were released. Designed by Universal Anything Services (UAS), they are a horticulture Doll that triggered the once popular trend of "Neo-Urbanism".

Besides functional modules for fruit and vegetable gardening, the LG-II also features high-end aesthetic appreciation which is calibrated to human sensibilities. These grant them a profound appreciation for horticulture.

In 2055, Sakuya drew a great deal of attention when she was purchased by the Toyoshima House, becoming the first horticultural Doll brought into the upper class.

In 2058, she was invited to participate in Project Neural Cloud as a representative of the horticultural Dolls.
infoStories:
Unlike the public's perception of "normal gardening", Dolls like Sakuya have a wide and deep wealth of knowledge. Their work isn't limited to just pruning trees and plants. In order to produce excellent crops and reap great economic benefits, they also need to be adept at science and technology.

Sakuya's first job was as an external consultant dispatched by UAS to a partnered agribusiness company to help guide their production bases.

Before being purchased by the Toyoshima House, Sakuya was appointed by UAS to host the 2054 International Horticultural Exposition. Her solo work, "Flowers Rising to Touch the Sky" was included in the "Green Art Weekly" selections. Imitations quickly emerged thereafter, forcing the legal department at UAS to create a special group dedicated to protecting Sakuya's creative copyright after the exhibition ended.

The Toyoshima House did not buy Sakuya because they had faith in Dolls. Precisely the opposite in fact—like others in the upper class, the Toyoshima House looked down upon the Dolls who practiced the arts, believing that they lacked the accumulated cultural knowledge, lacked any great insight that would allow them to represent that traditional glory.

But they were left without another option. The Toyoshima House encountered problems with their capital and had no choice but to reduce their expenses. Their gardeners, unable to accept the lower pay, left one by one. At this time, UAS, which had always wanted to expand its sales to the upper class, approached the Toyoshima House and sold Sakuya to them at a heavily discounted rate.

Even reduced to such a state, the Toyoshimas still could not let go of their pride. After reaching a cooperation agreement, they continued to question Sakuya's abilities even during the handoff, presenting a haughty attitude to convey what remained of their "dignity".

Sakuya did not take offense at this. In fact, she didn't pay these types of useless trifles any mind at all. To her, non-speaking plants are far cuter than noisy humans. It doesn't matter where you go, as long as you can continue to work.

From measurements, to design, to final implementation, Sakuya completed the renovation of the nearly 20,000 square-meter private garden of the Toyoshima House in just one month.

When the Toyoshima House reopened their gardens to the outside world, many people who had been waiting for a long time to laugh at them came over one by one, but none could utter a single word when they witnessed Sakuya's work.

That month, the LG-II sales department at UAS reported that sales were up 600%. The horticulture Dolls as represented by Sakuya were thoroughly recognized by the upper class.

Besides the garden's restoration, and thus the family's image, the Toyoshima House also received help from Sakuya in another way.

The word of their family's garden spread rapidly and Sakuya's unique gardening skills made convertees of many people in high places who, one after the other, contacted the Toyoshimas in hopes of borrowing Sakuya or purchasing some of her designs. The Toyoshimas seized upon this opportunity and were able to reverse their family's fortunes and reclaim their place in high society.

This caused Sakuya's status within the Toyoshima House to also gradually increase, eventually equaling that of their retainers—although she herself was not conscious of this fact.

As for the reward promised by the Toyoshimas, Sakuya didn't express any particular desire, merely stating that if there was an opportunity, she hoped to one day open a flower shop. As a result, the head of the Toyoshima House head quietly allocated an entire street that was under his name to Sakuya and dispatched his staff to assist with the preparations. They hoped to surprise Sakuya at the annual meeting the following year.

After joining Project Neural Cloud, Sakuya and Imhotep became fast friends. Imhotep gave her several video recordings she made during work, which featured all types of nature and ecological scenes. To repay her, Sakuya used her favorite anemone flowers as materials to make a kitty bonsai for her.

"Ah, that's a special something that Saki-chan made. Since she came to the Oasis, she hasn't given it to anyone else. Eh? Professor, you have one too?"
—Medical Department Communications Recordings
oathDesc: She blooms in silence, only for her beloved.

projections.name: Gardener
projections.desc:
Attire produced with Neural Cloud Projection upon a Doll's arrival in Magrasea. These are the clothes they are most comfortable in.
"The temple garden, deep and silent; penetrating the very rock, a cicada's voice. The east wind is blowing again..."

projections.name: World of Flora
projections.desc:
Attire and environment produced with Neural Cloud Projection upon a Doll's arrival in Magrasea, which mirrors their life in the real world.
"To see a world in a flower, and a bodhi in a leaf. All the grandeur this world has to offer perhaps still cannot compare to the beauty of changing seasons in a corner of my garden."

skinList.name: Warming Nocturnal Fragrance
skinList.desc:
From Cyber Media's "Theater Retro" series, which faithfully reproduces scenes from classic works, providing a brand new experience for you and your Dolls.
"Though flowers and food are nurtured in dramatically different ways, they're both quite interesting."

skinList.name: Relaxing Bloom
skinList.desc:
Snowy Spring — A special outfit that the Dolls wear during the Chinese New Year garden party. Bid farewell to the old and liven up the new with a splash of unique scenery.
"The flowers bloom to see off the old and welcome the new. What sort of festive flowers will you use to decorate this garden, Professor?"

skinList.name: Firestained Leaves
skinList.desc: Surging morale in a vicious battle keeps each and every Doll fighting until their final moments—whether on the offensive or defensive, at advantage or disadvantage. Memories, replicated in Magrasea with Neural Projection—""Blossoms may fade in the fires of war, but they shall grow again one day, more beautiful than ever. Before that, though, the pests in this garden must needs be removed.""

skinList.name: Wishing Projection
skinList.desc:
Warm embers fill the calm evening air as cinders drift down to earth, like fiery petals descending through the air. This would be the most beautiful sight of the Tanabata night for the Dolls.
""Good work, Professor. Even your clothes are wet. While the firework cheer's still hanging in the air, how about some chilled buckwheat noodles on a balmy night like this?""
